input.quote: Each of the Servicer and the Marketing Agent, severally and not jointly, will be liable only for its own willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence in performing its obligations under this Agreement.
input.rationale: The only limitation-of-liability language is the exculpation regime in Section 6.2(a) (counterparty) and Section 5.2(a) (our Depositor); there is no monetary cap anywhere, and the absence of a cap favours us as claimant, so we do not push a fees-based cap (a Servicing Fee-based cap would be illusory). The material failure is direction and mutuality: Section 6.2(a) makes Cellco liable "only" for willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence, whereas the mirror provision for the Depositor (p0243) omits "only". Coupled with the blanket waiver of "All other liability", the counterparty's exculpation is capable of excusing ordinary breach of its core performance obligations — the Servicer Deposit Obligation, the Servicer Acquisition Obligation and remittance of Collections — which are our principal recourse, i.e. an effectively zero-value, one-sided limitation in the counterparty's favour (walk-away territory under this rule). The Section 6.3 indemnities are likewise triggered only by willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence. The minimal edit deletes "only" to restore symmetry with Section 5.2(a) and states that the Servicer's/Marketing Agent's specific obligations and indemnities sit outside any limitation on liability, without importing a cap.

proposal.summary: Remove the one-sided "only" exculpation in Section 6.2(a) and confirm the Servicer's/Marketing Agent's specific obligations (deposit, acquisition and indemnity) sit outside any liability limitation.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 6.2(a) limits Cellco's liability to willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence, while the mirror provision for the Depositor (Section 5.2(a)) contains no such "only" — so we have deleted "only" to restore mutuality. We have also confirmed that the Servicer's and Marketing Agent's specific obligations, including the Servicer Deposit Obligation, the Servicer Acquisition Obligation, remittance of Collections and the Section 6.3 indemnities, sit outside any limitation on liability, consistent with our position that indemnification and core performance obligations are never capped; we are not proposing a fees-based cap, which would be illusory here.

ops.newText: Each of the Servicer and the Marketing Agent, severally and not jointly, will be liable for its own willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence in performing its obligations under this Agreement. Notwithstanding the foregoing, nothing in this Section 6.2 will limit, waive or release the liability of the Servicer or the Marketing Agent for the performance of its specific obligations under this Agreement and the other Transaction Documents, including the Servicer Deposit Obligation, the Servicer Acquisition Obligation, its obligations to deposit or remit Collections and its indemnification obligations under Section 6.3, none of which will be subject to any limitation or cap on liability.
